note: Eight quarterly calls Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27 opened from NSE archive PDFs (capacite.in IR page not updated after 2025; gurufocus paywalled; alphastreet Q1 FY26 link served another company). Quotes extracted through a PDF-to-text fetch: near-verbatim, pages +/-1. Rohit Katyal (Executive Chairman) gave nearly every answer on all calls. Q1 FY27 is pending: Q2 FY27 closed 30 Sep 2026 but results not filed by review date, so its items are open and excluded from score_10. Event grade = mean of item grades, rounded to 0.1; recency weights 7 (Q4 FY26) to 1 (Q2 FY25); the Rule 7 Q4 FY24 entry is shown but not weighted. Outcome figures are from management's own later call statements (FY26 revenue Rs 2,623 Cr, +11.6%; EBITDA 16.3%; order inflow Rs 4,446 Cr; FY26 CIDCO ~Rs 400 Cr, MHADA Rs 223.68 Cr), not from separately opened audited results. Pattern: order-inflow targets met or beaten on every call; revenue, project run-rate (CIDCO, MHADA, NBCC), debt and monetisation targets missed repeatedly; CIDCO Location 7 re-dated on six successive calls since May 2024. Bases differ across calls (total income vs revenue from operations; contract assets with or without debtors) - stated per item. No item met the SEVERE test, so no major-issue override. Item grades null = open or outcome [not retrieved].
